title: Rabbi Shimon of Katzetor
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Yuchasin identifies the Rabbi Shimon of Nazir 52b, who says of Rabbi Akiva, “Whether Rabbi Akiva retracted after he died, I do not know,” as Rabbi Shimon of Katzetor. Hyman says that this name is not found in the Gemara editions he consulted.

notes.text: The consulted Gemara and Rashi explicitly retain the “after he died” wording. Rashi explains that the remark was disparaging. The prior smoothing to “by the time he died” changed the meaning and is withdrawn. The proposed Katzetor identification remains Yuchasin’s claim.
